step_description: Unblock QUA-2 by implementing a deterministic, offline contract test suite (no AWS/network) and wiring it into the Hypergenium verifier so QUA-2 is no longer TODO/BLOCKED.
prompt_text:
You are a remediation agent executing the next Hypergenium roadmap step for this repo.

Context (source of truth)
- Roadmap: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md (Rubric v0.1.0)
- Rubric: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
- Evidence plan: hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
- Deterministic verifier entrypoint: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
- Current rubric report: hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json

Why this is the next step
- The current rubric report overall status is BLOCKED, with remaining blockers including QUA-2 (integration/contract tests), COM-6 (logging/ops standards), and SEC-4 (domain P0 tests).
- QUA-2 is currently BLOCKED because it is a TODO in the verifier (no configured command), not because a test suite is failing.
- We can unblock QUA-2 with an offline, deterministic contract test suite (no AWS, no network), which is safe to run in CI and provides real signal about the Lift CLI contract stability.

Step goal (what “done” means)
- QUA-2 must no longer be BLOCKED due to an unconfigured verifier command.
- After this step, running bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh must produce:
  - QUA-2 = PASS if contract tests pass, OR
  - QUA-2 = FAIL with actionable output (what contract invariant failed and where).
- Evidence must be refreshed under hgm-infra/evidence/, including QUA-2-output.log and an updated hgm-rubric-report.json.

Guardrails (strict)
- Do NOT weaken or remove any rubric requirements.
- Do NOT mark QUA-2 as N/A.
- Do NOT change toolchain pins, go.mod/go.sum, .golangci.yml, or any .github/workflows/* in this step.
- Do NOT add integration tests that require AWS credentials, cloud deployments, external services, or network access.
- Do NOT modify production code behavior (pkg/**, cmd/**).
- Allowed non-hgm-infra writes are limited to adding a NEW, test-only package for contract tests (see “Allowed write locations”).

Allowed write locations
- hgm-infra/** (verifier wiring + planning docs + evidence + progress note)
- internal/contracttests/** (NEW: test-only package containing contract tests; do not modify other internal packages unless absolutely required to fix a real contract mismatch)

Procedure
1) Confirm baseline (required)
   - Run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json that QUA-2 is BLOCKED with message indicating the verifier command is not configured.
   - Inspect hgm-infra/evidence/QUA-2-output.log and confirm it is a TODO placeholder.

2) Implement an offline contract test suite (new package, deterministic)
   Create a NEW Go test-only package that can be run directly as a single command.

   Suggested location (preferred): internal/contracttests
   - Create directory: internal/contracttests
   - Create file: internal/contracttests/cli_contract_v1_test.go

   Requirements for the tests:
   - Must run offline: no AWS SDK calls, no CDK deploys, no network.
   - Must be deterministic (stable ordering; do not depend on current time).
   - Must assert meaningful contract invariants that are important to keep stable.

   Minimum recommended invariants to test (v1 contract):
   A) Contract doc invariants (docs/cli-contract-v1.md)
      - File exists.
      - Contains a “version: 1” example.
      - Mentions stage keys: dev, staging, live (as code spans or otherwise; keep the check simple but specific).

   B) Template contract invariants (internal/templates/*/lift.yaml.tmpl)
      For each of the required template variants listed in the CON-3 verifier (basic-api, microservice, event-driven, merchant-app, sns-processor; and each with -pt), verify the template file exists and includes these keys:
      - version: 1
      - app: section with template: <templateName>
      - stages: section with dev:, staging:, live: keys
      - domains: section with base_domain:

   Implementation notes:
   - Prefer standard library only (testing, os, filepath, strings, regexp).
   - Compute repo root robustly inside the test (tests run with package working directory). For example: use os.Getwd() and walk upward until you find go.mod, then treat that as repo root.
   - When checking file contents, avoid overly brittle regexes; match for key lines and expected template name.

3) Wire QUA-2 into the deterministic verifier
   Update: hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Replace the QUA-2 TODO line with a real command, for example:
     run_check "QUA-2" "Quality" "go test ./internal/contracttests -v"
   - Keep all other checks unchanged.

4) Update planning artifacts to reflect the new verifier (no rubric dilution)
   Update: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
   - Change QUA-2 “How to verify” from TODO/BLOCKED to the new command you wired (or to the verifier entrypoint, but ensure it is no longer TODO).

   Update: hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
   - Update QUA-2 row so “How to refresh” is no longer TODO and points to the new deterministic command (or the main verifier).

   Optional but recommended (doc integrity):
   - Update hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md mapping table so QUA-2 status reflects that it is no longer “BLOCKED due to TODO”.

5) Refresh evidence (required)
   - Run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm:
     - hgm-infra/evidence/QUA-2-output.log now contains real test output (not TODO).
     - hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json shows QUA-2 as PASS (or FAIL if a real contract issue exists).

   If QUA-2 FAILS:
   - Fix ONLY the contract drift needed to make the contract consistent again (prefer doc/template alignment fixes; do not change production behavior).
   - Keep changes minimal and explain them in the progress note.

6) Record progress (required)
   - Create: hgm-infra/evidence/roadmap-progress-M3-QUA-2.md
   - Include:
     - Timestamp
     - What contract tests you added (high-level list of invariants)
     - Exact verifier command used for QUA-2
     - Final QUA-2 status and evidence pointers:
       - hgm-infra/evidence/QUA-2-output.log
       - hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json
     - Any follow-up work suggested (e.g., expand contract tests beyond doc/template invariants).

Acceptance criteria
- QUA-2 is not BLOCKED due to TODO; it is evaluated by a real command.
- The QUA-2 command is offline and deterministic.
- Evidence is refreshed under hgm-infra/evidence/ and the rubric report is updated.
- Only permitted paths were modified (hgm-infra/** and internal/contracttests/**).

If you get blocked
- If you cannot make the test suite deterministic (e.g., unstable file discovery ordering), STOP and fix determinism (sort lists) rather than weakening assertions.
- Do not revert QUA-2 back to TODO; prefer a smaller test suite that is correct and deterministic.
guardrails: Do not weaken or remove rubric requirements (no dilution)
Do not change toolchain pins, go.mod/go.sum, .golangci.yml, or .github/workflows/*
Do not add network/AWS-dependent integration tests for QUA-2; tests must run offline
Do not modify production code behavior in pkg/** or cmd/**
Write changes only under hgm-infra/** and (new) internal/contracttests/**
Refresh and record evidence only under hgm-infra/evidence/
